title: 第11章 得宝剑，收人心
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
内室。

    一刻钟后，余婉清捧着一柄狭长宝剑匆匆赶来，随即双手奉上，姿态恭敬：“王爷，这是婉清亲自为您挑选的。”

    经此一遭，她已发觉这位被贬的太子，绝非表面简单，不是自己能够算计的。

    陆舟挑眉，抬手接过，右手握紧剑鞘。

    不显突兀的纹理，握着极为舒适，且不易脱手。

    锵！

    宝剑出鞘，一声清越剑鸣随之而起。

    剑身酷似前世勾践古剑，遍布菱形暗纹，萦绕着淡淡的青冷寒光。

    剑脊笔直，线条飘逸利落。

    “精锻级？”陆舟意外道。

    作为曾经的大周太子，他的见识还是在的。

    “王爷好眼力。”余婉清垂眸，姿态愈发恭敬：“此剑能承受四品武者全力一击，算是我们商会的赔罪之礼。”

    世间兵器装备，主要分为四个级别。

    凡铁、精锻、天铸以及神兵！

    精锻级，已是市面上能拿出的最好之物。

    往上，唯有世家大族掌控，很少流通。

    “不错，余总管倒是大方！”陆舟随之起身，收剑入鞘。

    此剑明显是精锻中的佼佼者，外界少说也得卖接近百万两的白银。

    “王爷满意就好。”余婉清暗自松了一口气。

    陆舟不再多言。

    得了武技和宝剑，他心情极为不错。

    走出房间，周川和李雄还在寸步不离守着。

    “余总管，可否再帮本王这两位护卫挑选两门合适的武技？”陆舟侧头看向身后佳人。

    闻言，周川和李雄对视一眼，本想开口继续推辞。

    余婉清瞧出端倪，抢先一步道：“王爷放心，婉清一定为他们挑选好合适武技，到时候也算我们商会的一点小心意！”

    她心思活络，特意给双方一个台阶下，顺带还能展现商会诚意，为先前冒失算计赔罪。

    陆舟挑眉。

    这女人虽然心思重了一些，但还是挺会来事的。

    他没有拒绝对方的好意。

    至于周川和李雄，更是再无理由推脱了。

    那样，完全就是不给王爷面子！

    “王爷的恩情，我们二人铭记于心，往后若有差遣，我们定当全力以赴！”

    周川率先拱手，语气郑重。

    李雄也随声附和。

    虽说武技是免费的，但这也是因为陆舟的人情。
content_en:
Inner room.

    A quarter of an hour later, Yu Wanqing hurried over holding a long and narrow sword, and then offered it with both hands with a respectful gesture: "Your Highness, Wanqing personally selected this for you."

    After this experience, she has discovered that this demoted prince is by no means simple as he seems, and cannot be calculated by her.

    Lu Zhou raised his eyebrows, raised his hand to take it, and held the scabbard tightly in his right hand.

    There are no obtrusive textures, it is extremely comfortable to hold and not easy to take off.

    Clang!

    The sword was unsheathed, and a clear sword cry followed.

    The sword body resembles Goujian's ancient sword from the previous life, with diamond-shaped dark lines all over it, and a faint green and cold light lingering around it.

    The spine of the sword is straight and the lines are elegant and neat.

    "Precision-forged level?" Lu Zhou asked unexpectedly.

    As the former prince of Zhou Dynasty, his knowledge is still there.

    "Your Majesty, you have good eyesight." Yu Wanqing lowered her eyes and became more respectful: "This sword can withstand a full blow from a fourth-grade warrior. It can be regarded as an apology gift from our Chamber of Commerce."

    Weapons and equipment in the world are mainly divided into four levels.

    Ordinary iron, precision forging, heavenly casting and divine weapons!

    The precision-forged grade is already the best available on the market.

    Upward, only aristocratic families control it, and it rarely circulates.

    "Yes, Manager Yu is quite generous!" Lu Zhou then stood up and sheathed his sword.

    This sword is obviously the best in precision forging, and the outside world would say that it would be sold for close to one million taels of silver.

    "As long as the prince is satisfied." Yu Wanqing secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

    Lu Zhou said no more.

    He was in a very good mood after acquiring martial arts skills and a sword.

    After walking out of the room, Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong were still watching.

    "Mr. Yu, can you help my two guards choose two more suitable martial arts?" Lu Zhou turned his head and looked at the beautiful woman behind him.

    Hearing this, Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong looked at each other and wanted to continue to decline.

    Yu Wanqing saw the clues and took the lead and said: "Don't worry, Your Majesty, Wanqing will definitely choose suitable martial arts for them. Then it will be considered as a little thought from our Chamber of Commerce!"

    She was quick-thinking and deliberately gave both parties a step down. By the way, she could also show the sincerity of the Chamber of Commerce and apologize for the previous reckless calculation.

    Lu Zhou raised his eyebrows.

    Although this woman is a little more thoughtful, she is still quite capable.

    He did not refuse the other party's kindness.

    As for Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong, there is no reason to shirk anymore.

    That would completely disrespect the prince!

    "The two of us will keep your prince's kindness in mind. If we are called upon in the future, we will do our best!"

    Zhou Chuan took the lead in handing over his hand and spoke solemnly.

    Li Xiong also echoed.

    Although martial arts are free, this is also because of Lu Zhou's favor.
title_en: Chapter 11 Obtain the sword and win people's hearts
